outcome: exclusive breastfeeding rates at 3 and 6 months
cohort: 160 women who received prenatal nutrition consultations between 2014-2017 and gave birth to infants with congenital anomalies requiring intensive care.
finding: Lactation outcomes, including initiation and breastfeeding rates up to and beyond 12 months, among women who received prenatal nutrition consultations significantly surpassed national data.
